Some people move through the world quietly making it better. You're one of them — usually without even noticing you're doing it.

chapter one

The story so far.

A few years. A lot of memories. And somehow, all of them led to this version of you.

2006

The beginning.

The year a little person arrived and had absolutely no idea how many lives she would eventually become part of.

2010

Someone new joins the story.

Her brother arrives, and just like that, she's not the only one anymore — she's someone's big sister too.

2015

A little more you.

More stories, more mischief, more people beginning to know the person behind the smile.

2020

A different chapter.

New experiences, new versions of yourself, and the kind of growing-up that happens quietly.

2026

Here you are.

Older, wiser, still completely yourself — and with another chapter waiting to be written.

chapter four

From the people around you.

“I honestly don’t know how to put everything I feel into a few words, but I’m really grateful that you’re a part of my life. From the random conversations and stupid laughs to all the little moments that somehow became memories, I wouldn’t trade any of it. You’ve become someone incredibly special to me, and I hope you always remember how loved and appreciated you are. I hope this year brings you everything you’ve been wishing for and so much more. Happy Birthday, Riya. ❤️ Here’s to many more memories, adventures, and moments that we’ll look back on and laugh about someday.”

-Atharvaaa Prabhuu

“You deserve all the happiness, love and good things coming your way. Never forget how many people are lucky to have you in their lives. Keep smiling, keep being your crazy self, and please never change. Happy Birthday, Riya!”

-Shradha Singhh
To Riya —

There's no perfect way to sum up a year, or a person, in a page like this. So this isn't trying to. It's just a small stop to say: I see you, I see the effort you put into things nobody thanks you for, and I hope this year gives some of that back to you.

Wherever this year takes you — may it be lighter than the last, funnier than you expect, and full of people who show up for you the way you show up for everyone else.

Happy birthday. And seriously — don't ever underestimate how loved you are.

Happy Birthday, Riya.
here's to another year of becoming even more yourself.
